- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Combining all the factors into a single formula can help streamline the decision-making process for batching orders.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested formula to calculate a combined batchability score: Batchability Score = (Weight1 * Frustration Index) + (Weight2 * Additional Wait Time) + (Weight3 * Rider Status).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Rider Status can be represented as a binary value: 0 if the rider is en route to the restaurant, and 1 if the rider is already at the restaurant.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Weight1, Weight2, and Weight3 are the relative importance factors for the Frustration Index, Additional Wait Time, and Rider Status, respectively.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Lower scores indicate better batchability.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Using a single formula to evaluate batchability may not be the best solution for all scenarios and may require careful calibration of the weights.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional factors like rider capacity and package compatibility should also be considered when making decisions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It's essential to monitor the performance of your batching system and adjust the weights and acceptable thresholds based on your business goals and customer needs.
